summary: Added a Validation and Estate Health panel to the Steward Command Center that summarizes local validation, lifecycle, dependency, mailbox sync, recall audit, worker heartbeat, and work package completion/review artifacts with pass/warning/fail/missing/stale states, source links, recommended next action, and status bar health summary.
